Hey there SF! We are in search of green-minded people to join us at Oxyn to test our new blockchain app! During the pilot you will be able to return glass packaging for reusing and you'll get rewarded for that. All you'll need to do is download our app,  join our closed group of early birds on Discord and share your thoughts, and of course choose glass over plastic whenever possible! 
https://oxyn.io/individual
